Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his expression firm but concerned 😬.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 🤝.

JACK:
(suddenly alert)
No! I won't take it! It's poison! 🚽

DR. SMITH:
(calmly)
Jack, you're not thinking clearly. You need to take your medication to manage your symptoms 💊.

JACK:
(defiantly)
I won't do it! You can't make me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(firmly)
I'm ordering you to take your medication, Jack. Now 🚪.

Jack refuses, and Dr. Smith is forced to take the pills himself 💊. He swallows them down, feeling a sense of relief wash over him 😌.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith lies in his office, eyes closed, trying to relax after the ordeal 😴. Suddenly, he opens his eyes to find Jack standing in front of him, smiling innocently 😊.

JACK:
Hey, Doc! How are you feeling? 🤔

DR. SMITH:
(startled)
Jack...where did you come from? 🤯

JACK:
(laughing)
Oh, I just popped into your head, Doc! You know, like a figment of your imagination 🤪.

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth: he's been hallucinating the whole time, and Jack is just a product of his own paranoid delusions 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering)
Oh no...I'm the one who's been sick all along... 🤕

JACK:
(smiling)
Welcome to the club, Doc! You're not alone in your madness 😈.

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's eyes glaze over, and he begins to laugh maniacally, lost in his own delusions of grandeur 🤪.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
